const char *  name,
HxDBSpace_t *  space 
)

Open a database instance.

Open an instance of a database space. If no database was found, kHxDBNoDatabase is returned as the dataspace.

Parameters:
domain IN: Database domain
name IN: Database name, if custom database the name should be an absolute file path, otherwise just the name ` is required.
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful operation, otherwise an error code.

HxResult HxDBReadString ( const HxDBSpace_t  space,
const char *  key,
char *  value,
int *  valueSize 
)

: Read a string from the database instance

Read a string from the opened database instance using a key (string). The string is placed into an earlier allocated GString object. The application should take care of the GString memory allocation.

Parameters:
space IN: Currently valid HXDataspace instance
key IN: Key value (string)
value IN: Pointer to a buffer to hold the result string.
valueSize IN/OUT: Pointer to amount of storage caller has provided, and on return to the size needed to store the resulting string. If the call fails with HX_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL, it should succeed if called a second time after allocating this much storage.
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful operation, HX_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL if the incoming value of *valueSize indicates too little space for the value; otherwise an error code.

const char *  key,
const char *  value 
)

: Write a string to the database instance

Write a string to the opened database instance using a key (string). The string is not deallocated, it is the job of the application to deallocate any dynamic memory allocated for the string.

Parameters:
space IN: Currently valid HXDataspace instance
key IN: Key value (string)
value IN: String value
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful operation, otherwise an error code.
